evidence.claim: useEffect registers a ResizeObserver on document.body using observer.observe(document.body) but does not return a cleanup function to disconnect the observer when the component unmounts.
The observer callback captures payload and state, keeping retained allocations reachable via document.body after component unmount.

recommendedFix: Return a cleanup function from useEffect that calls observer.disconnect().
limitations: Static code review without runtime heap snapshot analysis.
